Description: (v26.3.1) AWS CFT to deploy a multi AZ spoke VPC for a GWLB A-A solution, repo: https://github.com/FortinetCloudCSE/fortigate-aws-gwlb-cloudformation

VPCCIDR.Description: Provide a network CIDR for the VPC
VPCCIDR.ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid CIDR block format.

NumOfAZs.Description: Select the number of Availability Zones to use (Min 2, Max 3)

PublicSubnetCIDRs.Description: Provide a list of network CIDRs for Public Subnets (Min 2, Max 3)

PrivateSubnetCIDRs.Description: Provide a list of network CIDRs for Private Subnets (Min 2, Max 3)

GwlbSubnetCIDRs.Description: Provide a list of network CIDRs for GLWB Subnets (Min 2, Max 3)

DistributedInspection.Description: Select an option for distributed inspection so VPC routes can be created (use Cwan or Tgw parameters below for centralized egress and/or east-west inspection)
AllowedValues: 5: No Distributed Ingress or Egress Inspection (use Cwan or Tgw for centralized inspection)

TransitGateway.Description: [Leave blank if Tgw will not be used] Provide the Transit GW ID to attach to

TransitGatewaySecurityRtb.Description: [Leave blank if Tgw will not be used] Provide the Transit GW RouteTable ID that the security VPC is associated to

TransitGatewaySpokeRtb.Description: [Leave blank if Tgw will not be used] Provide the Transit GW RouteTable ID that your spoke VPCs will be associated to

CloudWan.Description: [Leave blank if Cwan will not be used] Provide the Cloud WAN Core Network ID to attach to

CloudWanSegmentKey.Description: [Leave blank if Cwan will not be used] Provide the name that should be used to create a Tag on the Cwan VPC Attachment to allow CWAN attachment automation

CloudWanSegmentValue.Description: [Leave blank if Cwan will not be used] Provide the value that should be used to create a Tag on the Cwan VPC Attachment to allow CWAN attachment automation

VpcEndpointServiceName.Description: Provide the Vpc Endpoint Service Name that is associated to your Gateway Load Balancer.

RouteToCwanOrTgw.Description: [Ignore if Cwan or Tgw will not be used] Provide a network CIDR to create VPC routes to reach private resources via TGW or CWAN (0.0.0.0/0 for centralized egress and east-west or RFC-1918 for centralized east-west)

Fn::Equals: 5: No Distributed Ingress or Egress Inspection (use Cwan or Tgw for centralized inspection)

RouteToCwan.Description: VPC route to Cloud WAN in private subnets

TransitGatewaySecurityRtb.Description: Transit Gateway Route Table ID that the VPC will propagate to

TransitGatewaySpokeRtb.Description: Transit Gateway Route Table ID that the VPC is associated to

RouteToTgw.Description: VPC route to Transit Gateway in private subnets
